nodes.label: UTF-8 Encoding Policy
nodes.rationale: Text corruption would partially destroy system memory and project context.

nodes.label: Island Architecture Model
nodes.rationale: Island is the primary architectural boundary and maps to an autonomous application system; runtime technology must not alter the domain model.

nodes.label: Barrymore Read-Only Mode
nodes.rationale: Barrymore reads system state; changes are restricted to explicitly permitted tools and approved tasks.

nodes.label: Agents Never Access the OS Directly
nodes.norm_label: agents never access the os directly
nodes.rationale: All agent actions pass through controlled tools with explicit permissions.

nodes.label: Everything Is a Tool
nodes.rationale: Every agent-accessible action has a documented tool contract; no privileged action exists outside the registry.

nodes.label: No Executable Agent Runtime
nodes.rationale: The map states there is no executable bot, LLM client, runtime, or agent loop; markdown agent roles are not a runtime.

nodes.label: Estate Archipelago
nodes.rationale: Architectural domains are represented as islands and agents; the model combines software and visual estate concepts.

nodes.label: Read-Only Agent Rule
nodes.rationale: All agents remain read-only under ADR-003/004 unless the Sovereign explicitly expands their authority.

nodes.label: Context Recovery as Core Problem
nodes.rationale: The system aims to reduce the effort required to resume work after a break by preserving what happened, what is next, and why.

nodes.label: Tools-Only Agent Actions
nodes.rationale: Barrymore should operate only through permitted tools rather than directly accessing the operating system.

nodes.label: Agent Layer
nodes.rationale: The audit characterizes the agent layer as documentation and plans rather than a runtime.

nodes.label: Layer Boundaries
nodes.rationale: The audit found few implemented connections between Core, eVo, Interface, Memory, Modules, and Workspace.

nodes.label: Secret Management
nodes.rationale: The audit recorded exposed credentials in a committed experiment and recommended removal and rotation; sensitive values are intentionally omitted.

nodes.label: Static Dashboard
nodes.rationale: The dashboard has hardcoded islands and no connection to Memory; its Morning Brief content is static.

nodes.label: Source of Truth
nodes.rationale: The audit protocol says repository files and Git take precedence over engineering notes when they conflict.

nodes.label: Estate Archipelago
nodes.rationale: A central estate surrounded by domain islands, with agents receiving authority gradually after their roles are defined.

nodes.label: Estate
nodes.rationale: The user's central estate and the center of authority, decisions, and coordination.

nodes.label: Multi-Agent System
nodes.rationale: Agents have distinct identities, tools, responsibilities, and a message bus for passing work through a shared workflow.

nodes.label: Researcher
nodes.rationale: Investigates unknowns, forms and tests hypotheses, identifies patterns, and turns unknowns into knowledge.

nodes.label: eVo Command Center
nodes.rationale: A proposed SPA where system state should be understandable in one or two seconds through visual signals.

nodes.label: eVo
nodes.rationale: An Evolution Operating System intended to preserve and restore context.

nodes.label: Treasury
nodes.rationale: A Main Estate domain for finding and managing cash flows, judged by income relative to resources spent.

nodes.label: eVo 2.0 Visual Direction
nodes.rationale: A frozen, low-priority future visual concept: a subtle cyberpunk alley behind a curved atlas map, conveying knowledge flows and a living system; defer until eVo 1.x is stable.

nodes.label: Platform and eVo Vision Foundation Task
nodes.norm_label: platform and evo vision foundation task

nodes.label: Understanding as the Object of Development
nodes.norm_label: understanding as the object of development
nodes.rationale: Platform treats understanding, rather than documents, as the primary object of development.

nodes.label: P9 Preservation of Causality
nodes.rationale: The system preserves why changes occurred so important decisions can be reconstructed from discussions, decisions, and context.

nodes.label: Knowledge Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: The stated lifecycle is Capture ? Session ? Decision ? Context ? Snapshot, intended to restore working context after an interruption.

nodes.label: Memory as History of Thinking
nodes.rationale: Git preserves file history; Memory preserves the history of thinking.

nodes.label: Ordinary Files as Foundation
nodes.rationale: The system uses ordinary files to preserve both results and the context in which they arose.

nodes.label: Append-Only Engineering Log
nodes.rationale: Past entries are not edited or removed; errors are addressed through corrective entries.

nodes.label: Staged, User-Authorized Execution
nodes.rationale: A plan is not permission to execute; each stage starts only on an explicit user instruction.

nodes.label: Platform
nodes.rationale: A resilient life operating system for making decisions amid uncertainty and change.

nodes.label: International Career
nodes.rationale: A key path toward a stable international income and expanded life choices.

nodes.label: Migration as Opportunity Expansion
nodes.rationale: Relocation is being explored as a starting base for career growth, lower living costs, easier adaptation, and future mobility.

nodes.label: Module Adaptability
nodes.rationale: New modules should be addable without changing the core.

nodes.label: Platform Portability
nodes.rationale: The platform should not depend on a particular device, service, or application; ordinary files are the basis.

nodes.label: P11 Visibility of Evolution
nodes.rationale: System changes should be observable through Git history.

nodes.label: P7 Incremental Change Recording
nodes.rationale: Each change is recorded immediately in minimal, verifiable and reversible steps; long unbroken action chains are forbidden.

nodes.label: P1 Evolution
nodes.rationale: The system should change without rewriting its core; changes extend rather than destroy structure.

nodes.label: P2 Modularity
nodes.rationale: Each new direction is a separate module; modules interact across explicit boundaries.

nodes.label: P4 Structure Priority
nodes.rationale: Structure determines permitted content; content cannot directly change architectural rules.

nodes.label: P5 Minimization of Entities
nodes.rationale: Introduce an entity only when existing means cannot express the meaning.

nodes.label: P8 Separation of Core and Navigation
nodes.norm_label: p8 separation of core and navigation
nodes.rationale: Core excludes explanatory and navigation elements; these belong at the system entry point.

nodes.label: Why Each Component Exists
nodes.rationale: Each project component should be able to answer why it exists.

nodes.label: Draft Principles P9–P21
nodes.rationale: Draft principles are explicitly not part of the system; ideas include source-of-truth control, static/dynamic separation, one concept per term, and keeping drafts outside the system.

nodes.label: Intent-Based Automation
nodes.rationale: The user expresses intent while eVo handles the technical procedure as a single command.

nodes.label: Architectural Decisions
nodes.rationale: The directory stores fixed architectural decisions.

nodes.label: RFC Process
nodes.rationale: Significant Platform/eVo changes are proposed in RFCs before implementation; accepted, rejected, draft, and backlog proposals are organized by status.

nodes.label: Git Branching Model
nodes.rationale: Use two branches to separate stable work from experimentation without adding structural complexity.

nodes.label: Branch and Release Model
nodes.rationale: A predictable one-developer model uses one active development line and explicit stabilization points; releases follow completed, working features.

nodes.label: Platform Contour
nodes.rationale: Keep Platform in one repository, move unrelated/archival material out, treat generated graphify output as cache, and consolidate ADRs.

nodes.label: Single Platform Repository
nodes.rationale: The platform itself should not be split into multiple repositories; the decision cites minimizing entities.

nodes.label: Data-Driven Decision Principle
nodes.rationale: Decisions should be based on data rather than emotion, with plans reviewed regularly.

nodes.label: Platform as Life Operating System
nodes.rationale: The platform is imagined as an evolving, adaptive system where resilience matters more than a fixed plan.

nodes.label: P10 Evolution Through MVP
nodes.rationale: A capability starts as a minimal working version and grows only after validation.

nodes.label: Tasks, Decisions, and Reports as Sources of Truth
nodes.norm_label: tasks, decisions, and reports as sources of truth

nodes.label: Fast Git Capture Workflow
nodes.rationale: Git workflow should be fast enough to record a thought before it cools.

nodes.label: System Snapshot
nodes.rationale: A snapshot is a version of the system's state at a point in time.

nodes.label: Session History
nodes.rationale: Sessions preserve the history of changes in thinking.

nodes.label: Controlled AI Workflow
nodes.rationale: Work should proceed in short steps with verification after each step and no long uncontrolled action chains.
